name: Yarn Syndicate Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1946, Yarn Syndicate
Ltd is in the business of manufacturing 
and trading in textiles[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
YSL is a merchant exporter and trader of various types of yarn, raw cotton and fabrics including cotton yarn, polyester cotton yarn, polyester viscose yarn, flax yarn, jute yarn, 
bamboo yarn, organic yarn etc.

pros: Debtor days have improved from 1,068 to 100 days.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 350 days to 31.3 days
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -62.2%
